findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "botsharper_test_my_bot" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Test / improve / debug a Solana trading bot (pump.fun, PumpSwap, sniper, copy-trading bot): give the bot's public wallet address and get its REAL net result in SOL over the measured period, up to 60 days (fees included, unsold tokens valued at the lower of cost and market price), number of positions" → after: "Test / improve / debug a Solana trading bot (pump.fun, PumpSwap, sniper, copy-trading bot): give the bot's public wallet address and get its REAL net result in SOL over the measured period, up to 60 days (fees included, unsold tokens valued at the lower of cost and market price), number of positions"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool renamed since last scan
